name: @renjfk/opencode-notify
description: Attention notifications for OpenCode. Blinks Zellij tab, plays a sound, and posts a macOS desktop notification when a session goes idle, requests permission, or asks a question.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run fmt
scripts.e2e:docker: docker build -f e2e/Dockerfile -t opencode-notify-e2e . && docker run --rm -e E2E_ENDPOINT -e E2E_MODEL -e E2E_API_KEY_ENV -e E2E_PROVIDER_PACKAGE -e "${E2E_API_KEY_ENV:-E2E_API_KEY}" opencode-notify-e2e
